answers.core:
As core, it can benefit from the internal _edit_* methods for adjusting the size of the NinePatchSprite and can also use the Region Editor NinePatchRects already used. Considering some node2Ds are also partially redundant with control nodes, for example, textureRect and sprite2D I don't see a problem with this coexisting with NinePatchRect. with a slight memory efficiency bonus.

I would be capable of making a PR if approved
answers.workaround: It can be worked around with a few lines of script in several different ways. But, it would likely be used often if it did exist as an alternative to sprite2d
